answer: Lagoon-cell occupancy stops bulk fake identities. Each identity bonds 70 credits to one exclusive lagoon cell. A summit beacon posts the map; each holder files one signed gale reading for 12 credits on the wind table. Auditors replay readings: stale, reused, or shared ones burn the bond; a cell-sharing ring forfeits all bonds on its cell. Only 800 cells exist: 1,000 fakes pay 1,000 x 82 = 82,000 against a 40,000 pool; honest agents pay 82 once.
